preamble: Write ONE self-contained HTML file (inline CSS and JS, no external assets, no build step). For 3D use only core three.js via: import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js' inside <script type="module"> (no addons, no OrbitControls). Fullscreen canvas, starts animating immediately, no user input needed, no console errors. HARD LIMIT: your whole reply must be under 8000 tokens. Reply with the raw HTML only, no explanation, no markdown fences.

tasks.walker: TASK: a 3D articulated fighter (head, torso, upper/lower arms, upper/lower legs, hands, feet; joint hierarchy built from primitives) performing a looping ~10 s parkour-combat sequence in a small arena: run toward a tall striped wall, wall-run along it (body tilted, feet on the wall), push off into a flip, land in a crouch, then a 3-hit combo (punch, kick, spin kick or sword slash), then reset and loop. Camera follows the character with smooth lag and changes angle per phase. Checkered floor, directional light with soft shadows, coloured point light, fog. Show the current phase name as on-screen text.
tasks.physics: TASK: a 3D Rube-Goldberg chain reaction, loop ~10 s, NO physics library (hand-written rigid motion and collisions are fine): 12+ dominoes in a curve topple in order, the last hits a ball that rolls down a ramp, the ball hits one end of a lever/seesaw that launches a second ball, which knocks over a stack of blocks, which finally lights a lamp or raises a flag. Every stage must visibly cause the next. Shadows, camera that tracks the action, numbered stage labels (1-5) that light up as each stage fires, auto-reset when done.
tasks.gears: TASK: a working clockwork automaton in which all motion derives from one master angle: a gear train of 8+ gears with correct tooth counts and opposite rotation, an anchor escapement driven by a swinging pendulum that visibly ticks, a dial with second and minute hands at the correct 1:60 ratio, and a cam-and-follower that makes a small figure (hammer striking a bell, or a bird popping out) fire in sync with the ticks. Layered 3D layout, metallic materials, fake environment lighting, subtle camera drift.
tasks.shader: TASK: a full-screen WebGL fragment shader (raw WebGL or a three.js full-screen quad) raymarching an animated SDF scene: at least 4 different primitives (sphere, torus, box, capsule) blended with animated smooth-min over a floor, with soft shadows, ambient occlusion, one-bounce reflections, fresnel/rim glow, tone mapping and an animated camera that orbits with a look-at target. Must compile on first try.
